biological.citation: TAOK1 is associated with neurodevelopmental disorder and essential for neuronal maturation and cortical development (PMID: 33565190)
biological.summary: TAOK1 is a MAP3K protein kinase regulating MAPK pathways. Altered TAOK1 expression levels in embryonic mouse brain affect neural migration in vivo and neuronal maturation in vitro. Identified 23 individuals with de novo TAOK1 variants (truncating, nonsense, and missense) causing neurodevelopmental disorder with developmental delay, intellectual disability, hypotonia, and feeding difficulties.

biological.citation: Corylifol A ameliorates muscle atrophy by inhibiting TAOK1/p38-MAPK/FoxO3 pathway in cancer cachexia (PMID: 37439183)
biological.summary: TAOK1 is a direct binding target of Corylifol A. TAOK1 activates p38-MAPK pathway, which increases FoxO3 nuclear localization and promotes ubiquitin proteasome system-mediated protein degradation in muscle. TAOK1 inhibition decreases both UPS-mediated degradation and autophagy in cancer cachexia models.

biological.citation: Oxaloacetate sensing promotes innate immune antiviral defence against influenza virus infection (PMID: 40983701)
biological.summary: TAOK1 phosphorylates the transcription factor ETS2 at serine 313 when recruited by cytosolic malate dehydrogenase 1 (MDH1) in response to oxaloacetate sensing. Phosphorylated ETS2 translocates to nucleus to support TBK1 expression and type I interferon responses against influenza virus.

biological.citation: Senescence-targeted MicroRNA/Organoid composite hydrogel repair cartilage defect and prevention joint degeneration via improved chondrocyte homeostasis (PMID: 38855061)
biological.summary: miR-24 targets TAOK1 to alleviate cellular senescence and promote chondrogenesis in SMSC organoids. TAOK1 downregulation by miR-24 reduces senescence markers and improves chondrocyte homeostasis through effects on glycolysis, OXPHOS, cell cycle, and ferroptosis pathways.
biological.sample_size: Osteoarthritic cartilage defect patients; rat cartilage repair model

biological.citation: TAOK1 promotes filament formation in HR repair through phosphorylating USP7 (PMID: 40106350)
biological.summary: TAOK1 phosphorylates ubiquitin specific peptidase 7 (USP7), enhancing its enzymatic activity to prevent RAD51 ubiquitylation and degradation. This promotes RAD51 filament formation essential for homologous recombination DNA repair. TAOK1 inhibition impairs HR repair and increases PARP inhibitor sensitivity in cancer cells.

biological.citation: Thousand and one amino acid protein kinase 1 suppression improves doxorubicin-induced cardiomyopathy by preventing cardiomyocyte death and dysfunction (PMID: 39964965)
biological.summary: CRISPR kinome-wide screen identified TAOK1 as a regulator of doxorubicin-induced cardiomyocyte death. TAOK1 suppression prevents DOX-induced sarcomere disarray, contractile dysfunction, DNA damage, and mitochondrial dysfunction through p38 MAPK pathway inhibition. AAV-mediated TAOK1 silencing attenuated myocardial damage in mouse DIC model.

biological.citation: Shenling Baizhu Powder and Betulin attenuate sepsis-induced intestinal injury by targeting GADD45B/TAOK1/p38 MAPK pathway (PMID: 40653040)
biological.summary: TAOK1 is a downstream target of GADD45B in the GADD45B/TAOK1/p38 MAPK pathway regulating intestinal epithelial cell apoptosis during sepsis. Betulin increases DNA methylation in TAOK1 promoter, reducing TAOK1 expression and p38 MAPK activation to prevent intestinal barrier dysfunction and cell death.
biological.sample_size: Sepsis mice (CLP model); LPS-induced IEC-6 cells

biological.citation: The potential of TAOK1 as a new therapeutic target for the treatment of cancer cachexia-associated muscle atrophy (PMID: 40339965)
biological.summary: TAOK1 is activated in cancer cachexia-induced myotube atrophy and tumor-bearing mice. TAOK1 knockout in C2C12 myoblasts confers resistance to cachexia-induced atrophy by increasing muscle protein expression and decreasing MAPK/FoxO3/UPS pathway activation. TAOK1 inhibitor CP43 ameliorates both in vitro and in vivo muscle atrophy.

biological.citation: TAOK1 Promotes Proliferation and Invasion of Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer Cells by Inhibition of WWC1 (PMID: 36158126)
biological.summary: TAOK1 is upregulated in NSCLC cell lines and specifically interacts with WWC1 (WW and C2 domain containing 1) protein. TAOK1 promotes NSCLC cell proliferation and invasion by downregulating WWC1. TAOK1 knockdown decreases invasion and increases apoptosis; TAOK1 overexpression shows opposite effects.
biological.sample_size: NSCLC cell lines; nude mouse xenografts

biological.citation: Deferasirox Targets TAOK1 to Induce p53-Mediated Apoptosis in Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma (PMID: 40003990)
biological.summary: Deferasirox (DFO) binds directly to TAOK1 and reduces its kinase activity. TAOK1 inhibition increases p53-mediated apoptosis through upregulation of p53, p-p53 (S15), p-p53 (S46), Puma, Noxa, and Bax, and downregulation of Bcl-2. DFO treatment reduces ESCC tumor growth in patient-derived xenograft models.
biological.sample_size: ESCC cell lines; PDX mouse models

biological.citation: ASHG 2017 - Novel de novo TAOK1 variants associated with a neurodevelopmental phenotype, macrocephaly, and joint hypermobility
biological.summary: Identified 7 unrelated individuals with novel de novo heterozygous TAOK1 variants (missense, nonsense, frameshift, splice site) through exome screening of 9,302 neurodevelopmental disorder cases. TAOK1 is a Ste20-related MAP3K maintaining mitotic microtubule dynamics and chromosome segregation. Clinical features include severe intellectual disability, autism spectrum disorder, learning disabilities, hypotonia, macrocephaly, and joint hypermobility.
biological.sample_size: 7 individuals with de novo TAOK1 variants

biological.citation: A Genome- and Phenome-Wide Association Study to Identify Genetic Variants Influencing Platelet Count and Volume and their Pleiotropic Effects (PMID: ASHG 2012)
biological.summary: TAOK1 identified as a kinase gene associated with platelet count variation in GWAS of 13,582 European ancestry participants. TAOK1 variants show pleiotropic effects associated with diverse phenotypes including autoimmune diseases, hematologic disorders, hypothyroidism, and myocardial infarction.
